name: Futagawa Miharu
source:
A beautiful gal with a wide array of expression.
She has a strong temperament despite her wide-eyes face, but is friendly to everyone despite it.
She is not afraid to meet new people and tends to befriend them easily. She enjoys doing whatever she's interested in, and will do anything she can to make a difference.
She noticeably has one of the biggest breasts in the dorm, and dresses in a way that accentuate her figure, but she does this since this is her preferred style. In spite of her appearance, she is innocent and pure-hearted who is shy about her love-life.
